easyPrerequisites: You do not control an Army.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Orcish Bowmasters, adding {C}{C}.
When Orcish Bowmasters dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Orcish Bowmasters from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target and creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
